2 صوّر [inf. n. تَصْوِيرٌ,] He formed, fashioned, figured, shaped, sculptured, or pictured, him, or it; (S, M, K;) and ↓ تصوّر signifies the same; (Msb, and Bd in iii. 4;) and so does ↓ صار , accord. to Aboo-'Alec, in the saying, “بَنَاهُ وَصَلَّبَ فِيهِ وَصَارَا
” [Which (referring to a church) he has built, and in which he has made a cross, or crosses, and has made sculptured, or painted, work]. (M.) One says, صَوَّرَهُ ٱللّٰهُ صُورَةً حَسَنَةً [God formed him a goodly, or beautiful, form]. (S.) ―
-b2- See also 5, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
